verdict.rationale: Docs show Devin running commands in its own terminal, building and testing iOS/macOS and Android apps on its own machines, booting into a preconfigured environment, and iterating on CI failures via Devin Review Auto-Fix. That supports running and validating code. However, nothing documents Devin writing new tests for its own changes, and the CI iteration happens after a PR is raised rather than before proposing it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic test generation, a documented pre-PR self-validation loop, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
